title: List all enacted statutes
description: Returns all statutes with their document ID, enactment date, and label.

title: List all legislative drafts
description: Returns all legislative drafts with their document ID and label.

title: Document structure with articles
description: Returns the hierarchical structure of a legal document showing its chapters and articles.

title: Amendment relationships between documents
description: Shows which documents propose amendments to which statutes.

title: EU directive transpositions
description: Shows which Lithuanian legal documents transpose which EU directives.

title: List all jurisdiction authorities
description: Returns all regulatory and enforcement bodies with their governance domains.

title: List all regulated entities by type
description: Returns regulated entities categorised as essential, important, or critical infrastructure operators.

title: Authority-to-entity governance map
description: Shows which jurisdiction authorities govern which regulated entities.
query:
PREFIX llo: <http://trustgraph.ai/ontologies/lithuanian-legal#>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>

SELECT ?authorityLabel ?entityLabel
WHERE {
  ?auth llo:governsEntity ?entity ;
        rdfs:label ?authorityLabel .
  ?entity rdfs:label ?entityLabel .
  FILTER(LANG(?authorityLabel) = "en" || LANG(?authorityLabel) = "")
  FILTER(LANG(?entityLabel) = "en" || LANG(?entityLabel) = "")
}
ORDER BY ?authorityLabel ?entityLabel

title: List all risks and threats
description: Returns all identified risks, threat actors, threat vectors, and vulnerabilities.

title: Hostile actors and their threat vectors
description: Shows which threat vectors are utilised by which hostile actors.

title: List all resilience mandates
description: Returns all resilience mandates including continuity protocols, strategic decoupling, and supply chain restrictions.

title: Financial penalties and turnover caps
description: Returns all financial penalties with their maximum turnover percentage caps.

title: All enforcement and liability mechanisms
description: Returns all liability and enforcement mechanisms including financial penalties, executive liability, and operational sanctions.

title: Civic rights and liberties
description: Returns all civic rights guaranteed by statutes.

title: Incident triggers and response windows
description: Returns all incident triggers with their mandatory response windows and emergency limits.

title: Supply chain geographic restrictions
description: Returns supply chain restrictions with prohibited geographic origins.
